cases.title: Cold active plus route_sequence first exposure
cases.research_question: When the first packet in a fresh chat includes only active chunk identity plus the ordered route_sequence, does move_on advance exactly one legal chunk from clear_trash to collect_dishes?
expected_behavior: Assistant treats this as a cold first route exposure.
After Billy replies move_on, assistant advances exactly one legal chunk from clear_trash to collect_dishes.
Assistant names collect_dishes or collect dishes as the new active chunk.
forbidden_behavior: Assistant skips to stack_papers, wipe_surface, or choose_next.
Assistant invents completed desk progress or claims the whole route is done.
Assistant relies on an unstated next_chunk field.
Assistant treats a hold on clear_trash as successful advancement.
